$comment: Fictional AI SaaS ad copy. Each start alternative is 'headline|subline'. {$product} is an invented name from src/content/names.ts, bound once so the headline and subline agree. Real SF SaaS boards are bold text on flat colour: keep headlines short, let the subline land the joke, punch up at the industry, never at people on the street.

billboard.description: Roadside and rooftop billboards (US-101, SoMa rooftops, Bay Bridge approach).

busWrap.description: Side wraps on city buses: one long line plus a kicker.
